source_en: Complete document checklist, ₹200 official statutory fee breakdown, and step-by-step application instructions for Learner Licence across all Indian states.
current_translation: पूरी दस्तावेज़ चेकलिस्ट, ₹200 आधिकारिक सरकारी शुल्क विवरण, और सभी भारतीय राज्यों के लिए लर्नर लाइसेंस आवेदन के चरण-दर-चरण निर्देश।

current_translation: सारथी परिवहन पोर्टल पर फॉर्म 2 जमा करें

source_en: Go to parivahan.gov.in, choose your State, and select 'Apply for Learner Licence'. Fill out your applicant details, address, and select vehicle class (MCWG for geared motorcycle, LMV for car).
current_translation: parivahan.gov.in पर जाएं, अपना राज्य चुनें और 'Apply for Learner Licence' चुनें।
आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ और फोटो अपलोड करें

source_en: Upload scanned copies of Proof of Age, Proof of Address, and Form 1 (Self-declaration of physical fitness). If not using Aadhaar e-KYC, upload your signature and passport-size photograph.
current_translation: आयु प्रमाण, पते का प्रमाण और फॉर्म 1 (शारीरिक फिटनेस घोषणा) की स्कैन की गई प्रतियां अपलोड करें।

source_en: Take the Computerized Learner Test (LL Test)

source_en: Download & Print Your Digital Learner Licence (Form 3)

source_en: Step-by-step procedure to convert your Learner's Licence into a Permanent Driving Licence. Complete document checklist, official government fees (₹700), and driving test rules.
current_translation: लर्नर लाइसेंस के बाद भारत में स्थायी ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस के लिए आधिकारिक प्रक्रिया, आरटीओ टेस्ट स्लॉट बुकिंग और शुल्क विवरण।

source_en: Ensure at least 30 days have elapsed since your Learner's Licence (LLR) was issued, and that your LLR has not expired (must be within 180 days of issue).
Submit Form 2 Application on Sarathi Parivahan
Visit sarathi.parivahan.gov.in, select your State, and click 'Apply for Driving Licence'. Enter your Learner's Licence number and date of birth to load your details automatically.
Select Vehicle Classes & Driving School Certificate

Choose the vehicle classes endorsed on your learner permit (e.g. Motorcycle with Gear - MCWG, Light Motor Vehicle - LMV). If you were trained at an accredited driver training institute (ADTC), upload your Form 5B certificate.

Pay the statutory government fee of ₹200 for DL issue, ₹200 for smart card printing, and ₹300 per vehicle class test fee (Total ₹700 for single class, ₹1,000 for dual class MCWG + LMV) via Bharatkosh or state payment gateway.
Book Practical Driving Test Appointment Slot
Select your designated RTO or Automated Driving Test Track (ADTT) and pick an available date and time slot. Download and print the Appointment Slip.
Appear for the Practical Driving Test at RTO Track

Arrive at the RTO test track 30 minutes before your slot with a vehicle corresponding to your application category. For two-wheelers, demonstrate figure-of-eight (8) balancing and sudden stopping. For four-wheelers, pass the H-track reverse parking, parallel parking, and gradient hill restart without rolling backwards.
Test Results and Biometric Data Verification
If you pass the test, the testing officer signs your inspection sheet or the automated track sensors submit an instant electronic pass report. Your digital photo and signature are verified.
Receive Driving Licence via Speed Post & DigiLocker

Your permanent driving licence number is generated within 24-48 hours and available on DigiLocker and mParivahan. The physical chip-based Smart Card licence is printed and dispatched to your residential address via India Post Speed Post.

source_en: Register or Log In to Official Passport Seva Portal
Visit passportindia.gov.in, select your residential Passport Office based on your current city, and register a new account or log in with your existing Passport Seva credentials.
Select 'Apply for Fresh Passport / Re-issue of Passport'

Click 'Apply for Fresh Passport / Re-issue of Passport' from the user dashboard. Select 'Re-issue of Passport', choose reason (Validity Expired within 3 years / Due to Expire), select booklet size (36 pages standard or 60 pages jumbo), and scheme (Normal or Tatkaal).
Fill the Online Application Form Details

Enter your applicant details, family details (father, mother, spouse), current residential address, emergency contact, and existing passport number, issue date, and expiry date. Provide details of two local references residing in your neighbourhood.

Click 'Pay and Schedule Appointment'. Pay ₹1,500 (for standard 36-page normal booklet) or ₹2,000 (for 60-page jumbo booklet) via SBI ePay, Internet Banking, Credit/Debit card, or UPI. Payment is mandatory to book an appointment slot.
Schedule Appointment at Nearest PSK or POPSK

Select your nearest Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) or Post Office Passport Seva Kendra (POPSK) and choose an available date and time slot. Print or download the Application Receipt showing your ARN and appointment batch time.
Visit the PSK with Original Documents

Arrive 15 minutes before your scheduled appointment time. You will proceed through three internal counters: Counter A (token generation, biometric fingerprint scan, and digital photo capture), Counter B (document verification by government verifying officer), and Counter C (granting officer approval).

If current address has changed, local police station conducts in-person physical address verification. The police officer visits your residence to check original address proof and verify your two local references.
Receive Renewed Passport via Speed Post

Once police verification report (PVR) is cleared, your passport is printed at the India Security Press and dispatched via India Post Speed Post. You will receive an SMS with the Speed Post tracking consignment number.
